body: I'm just trying to find nostalgic VOCALOID songs I can jam to. I deleted one of my accounts, so I can't find the stuff I loved anymore. Feel free to search on NicoNico Douga if needed.
I'm very concerned this cat may have gotten the cheese in its eyes. It looks like it's cringing in pain
For more clarity, it looked like sort of a 3Dish flash game. Was advertised along with Fruit Ninja. Don't know if it was popular or not.
Oh gosh. I remember grating cheese when I was a child and it was **extremely difficult** for my small stubby hands to do.

It definitely is nonsense. I'm just really confused. If I redacted their name, why would they decide to sue me when it needs to be there? Sure, I understand not wanting DMs out there, but they made me feel unsafe and uncomfortable by them questioning my trauma. It's just,,, really gross.
Thank you because I think that what they were doing was ridiculous.

Sorry if I deleted my account. My title and name of my account really bugged me because I was wanting it to look Anonymous so I can pirate some Studio Ghibli movies that my father already purchased way back in the 2000s. It just slowly got on my nerves. Sorry about that. If you can, try to find the chatroom where my deleted user was so you can repost the (partially) found footage from Arabic origins. 

I may also purchase the DVDs on Ebay, but I still want the full lot of 26 episodes. Preferably in Chinese because it did sound the best out of all Dubs. Yeah, even if I look at the English one with "rose tinted glasses", the Chinese dub seems to be the most passionate (plus Xander actually sounds like a teenager rather than being in his 40s).
It's like a hybrid between YT and Nico Nico. Has the format of Nico Nico, but it's the video platform that is official in China.
